services.name: Farm stand
services.blurb: Open six and a half days, stocked with whatever the Wiregrass sand gave us this week.

services.name: Seasonal produce
services.blurb: Sweet corn by Memorial Day, watermelon in July, green and boiled peanuts in August.

services.name: Pick-your-own strawberries
services.blurb: Our berries come in by mid-March, weeks ahead of most of the South.

services.name: Pasture-raised eggs
services.blurb: Hens on pasture under the pines, eggs on the stand by nine each morning.

services.name: Grass-fed beef
services.blurb: Halves and quarters from cattle on bahia grass, cut and wrapped in Dothan.

services.name: Pastured pork
services.blurb: Shoulders, chops and sausage, ready for a Friday pickup when you call by Tuesday.

services.name: Raw honey
services.blurb: Spring wildflower and summer jars from hives along the field road.

services.name: Pumpkin patch
services.blurb: October weekends with a wagon ride past the peanut fields at harvest time.

services.name: Choose-and-cut Christmas trees
services.blurb: Leyland cypress and Virginia pine, a saw on loan, shaken out and tied on.

services.name: Farm tours & field trips
services.blurb: Classes see a peanut plant pulled up, ride the wagon and take home a pumpkin.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Every August we stop for a bag of boiled peanuts coming back from the coast. Still hot, salted right, and they will sell you green peanuts by the pound to boil at home.
reviews.name: Velma J.

reviews.text: Took two kindergarten classes out in October. They watched a peanut plant come up out of the sand, rode the wagon, and every child carried home a small pumpkin. Shade and restrooms were ready for us.
reviews.name: Thaddeus M.

reviews.text: We cut a Virginia pine the second week of December. They lent us the saw, shook it out and tied it on the roof. The den smelled like the woods for a month.
reviews.name: Rosalind C.

reviews.text: Strawberries come in earlier here than anywhere my sister lives. Picked a full gallon on the twentieth of March in short sleeves.
reviews.name: Odell S.

reviews.text: Earline knows her cuts. I asked for a pork shoulder for a church supper and it was ready that Friday, wrapped, with a note on cook time.
reviews.name: Nadine W.

reviews.text: Sweet corn by Memorial Day, every year. We buy five dozen and put it up in the freezer in one long Saturday.
reviews.name: Lamar E.

proof.guarantee: If your tree drops its needles before Christmas Day, bring it back and cut another.

seo.title: Farm Stand, U-Pick & Trees in Dothan, AL | Sand Road Farm
seo.description: A Wiregrass farm near Dothan, AL: strawberries in March, sweet corn in May, boiled peanuts in August, trees in December. See what is in, then come out.
